parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The type of content in the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
- **0**: keyword.
- **2**: regular expression.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The content of the sensitive data detection rule. The content can be a regular expression or keyword used to match sensitive data fields or text.

parameters.name: ContentCategory
parameters.description:
The content type. Valid values:

- **1**: SQL injection exploitation attempt.
- **2**: SQL injection bypass attempt.
- **3**: stored procedure abuse.
- **4**: buffer overflow.
- **5**: error-based SQL injection.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MatchType
parameters.description:
The match type. Valid values:
- **1**: rule-based match.
- **2**: dictionary-based match.

parameters.name: ModelRuleIds
parameters.description: The collection of model IDs for sensitive data auditing.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the sensitive data detection rule.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The name of the product to which the column data in the data asset table belongs. Valid values: **MaxCompute**, **OSS**, **ADS**, **OTS**, **RDS**, and others.

parameters.name: ProductId
parameters.description:
The ID that corresponds to the product name of the data asset. Valid values:
- **1**: MaxCompute
- **2**: OSS
- **3**: ADS
- **4**: OTS
- **5**: RDS
- **6**: SELF_DB

parameters.name: RiskLevelId
parameters.description:
The sensitivity level ID of the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
- **1**: N/A. No sensitive data is detected.
- **2**: S1. Level-1 sensitive data.
- **3**: S2. Level-2 sensitive data.
- **4**: S3. Level-3 sensitive data.
- **5**: S4. Level-4 sensitive data.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The feature type of the rule. Valid values:
- **1**: data detection rule.
- **2**: audit policy.
- **3**: outlier detection rule.
- **99**: custom rule.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the rule. Valid values:
- **1**: enabled.
- **0**: disabled.

parameters.name: SupportForm
parameters.description:
The asset form supported by the rule. Valid values:
- **0**: all assets.
- **1**: structured assets.
- **2**: unstructured assets.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The target product code. Valid values: **MaxCompute**, **OSS**, **ADS**, **OTS**, **RDS**, and others.

parameters.name: TemplateRuleIds
parameters.description: The collection of template IDs for sensitive data auditing.

parameters.name: WarnLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level. Valid values:
- **1**: low.
- **2**: medium.
- **3**: high.
